businesses.business: surgical devices and regenerative tissue products

offering_description.value: Integra designs and manufactures neurosurgical devices, precision surgical instruments, and ear, nose and throat devices for hospitals and surgical centers. It also makes regenerative tissue products for surgical reconstruction and advanced wound care, selling through its own sales teams and distributors.

primary_products.value: neurosurgical implants and monitors; precision surgical instruments; ear, nose and throat devices; regenerative tissue matrices; advanced wound dressings

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, ambulatory surgical centers, and wound care clinics

end_markets.value: neurosurgery; general surgery; otolaryngology; reconstructive surgery; advanced wound care

revenue_model.value: product sales: surgical instruments and equipment, implants, and single-use surgical and wound care supplies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns device components and biomaterials into surgical and tissue products for healthcare facilities

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: neurosurgical devices, precision instruments, ear, nose and throat devices, and regenerative tissue products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: specialty sales teams serving hospitals, surgical centers, and wound care clinics; distributors / dealers: medical device distributors in international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: surgical devices and tissue products subject to FDA requirements and equivalent regulations abroad

notes: The current scope of private-label manufacturing is uncertain.
